title: Knotted Dense Russian Egg Dumplings
description: A traditional Russian dish featuring egg roll wrappers and Mediterranean-friendly ingredients, steamed to perfection in a Korean brass bowl.

ingredients.name: Egg roll wrappers
ingredients.notes: found in the frozen food section

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine warm water, yeast, and sugar, and let it sit for 5 minutes until the yeast is activated.
Add the egg roll wrappers to the bowl and let them soak in the yeast mixture for 10 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, and chopped fresh dill.
Add the crumbled feta cheese to the egg mixture and stir until well combined.
Remove the egg roll wrappers from the yeast mixture and cut them into quarters.
Place a small spoonful of the egg and feta mixture onto the center of each wrapper quarter.
Fold the wrapper into a knot and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Place the dumplings in a Korean brass bowl and drizzle with olive oil.
Steam the dumplings over boiling water for 10 minutes, or until they are cooked through and fluffy.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
